name: What is the typical cost to repair water damage around one window?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost to repair water damage around one window?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to repair water damage around a single window in the Bay Area varies widely based on the extent of the damage. Minor repairs, like recaulking and repainting, might range from $300 to $800. If the damage involves replacing sections of drywall, insulation, or parts of the window frame due to rot, costs can range from $1,500 to $4,000 or more. Extensive structural damage or mold remediation will significantly increase the price. A proper assessment is needed to provide an accurate estimate, as unseen damage can often be more severe than surface indications.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs range from $300 for minor fixes to $4,000+ for extensive damage involving structural repairs or mold, varying by severity.
